segments.text: In the vast darkness of space, a pair of glowing eyes stare down at the Earth. A celestial being watching.
Down below, the sky itself shows those eyes.
People scream and run in panic,
except one man standing calm in the middle of the street, holding his plastic bag.
Then a stranger appears on every screen. He says he will handle it.
He stands on the peak of Mount Everest,
preparing his attack.
He calls for his partner.
She's a giant woman, 10,000 meters tall.
After years of never being seen, she finally shows herself.
The heat of the Earth is becoming unbearable, and she wants to end this quickly.
He raises a handful of glowing orbs, ready to throw them.
Their purpose is to grant her power.
The orbs begin linking with her.
One attaches to her wrist,
forming armor and a weapon around her.
She launches herself into the sky,
charging straight for the celestial being.
Down below, her partner watches,
astonished.
Then a finger pierces through the sky.
It is many times larger than the giant woman herself.
It was as simple as crushing an ant.
The man with the bag can only stare. His bag slips from his hand
as the finger comes down toward him.
He whispers a name, "Amber Lockhart?" The girl he remembers, the one who looks just like the celestial being.
And then the Earth was gone.
Suddenly, time rewinds three years back inside a classroom
in the middle of a lesson.
The man with the bag is awake. He has regressed.
He goes peeking to another classroom and sees her,
Amber Lockhart. Perfect grades, nothing is ever a challenge for her,
but she sits alone, always a loner.
He can't understand it. What could make someone like her destroy the Earth?
But if the future can be changed, he's going to find out.
